name.description: Public name the issuing account knows the subject by.

account.description: Account uid that issued the contact.

signer.description: Key that signed the contact; matches `account` when omitted in legacy storage.

updateTime.description: Time the contact was last updated.

subscribe.description: Subscription preferences toward the subject's site and profile.

description: A contact as the API returns it: who named whom what, signed by which key, with timestamps and subscription preferences.
